name: SS - Lookbook Scroll
description: Cinematic horizontal-scroll lookbook gallery. Full-bleed images with editorial captions, Ken Burns zoom on hover, autoplay with progress bar, dot + arrow navigation, parallax depth, and overlay text positioning. Each slide has its own image, headline, subtitle, link, and badge. Supports light/dark themes, glassmorphism captions, custom fonts, and scroll-snap navigation. 70+ customization options. Perfect for fashion lookbooks, editorial campaigns, and visual storytelling.
